title: FIG. 08 · Phase gantt
summary: A's clean head and plate with C's gantt as the centrepiece, merged into one figure: four phase columns read left to right from '01 · Start', each with one short line, and the bars build underneath them in the same order until the red Calibrate bar runs on through the edge.

reference.site: Round 1 · A 'The Phase Climb' + C 'Phase Gantt Sheet' (Wild)
reference.borrowed: From C (after Wild's 'We build it with you' schedule): the phase gantt itself. The bars are staggered one phase per lane, there are dashed construction lanes, the bars plot in phase order, the highlight moves from bar to bar as the phase steps, Diagnose is the only fixed span, and Calibrate runs out through the edge. From A: the head grammar (red-square label, two-voice statement, 48×2 rule, lede, bottom-right note), one flat plate, four equal phase columns with an index and a 32px name, and the 2px rail that slides to the selected phase.
reference.kelwin: The two halves are now one plate. The four phase columns sit on top and are the tabs (no separate tab row, no spec column), each with an index, a 32px name and one short output line taken from the source copy. The gantt sits directly beneath them in the same four bays, drawn with the MEASURE primitive: a calibrated ruler forms the seam between the text and the chart, with one ten-tick segment over each bar. Each bar is 10px high and starts on its column's text edge. It stops short of the bay divider, so no two bars touch and the chart reads as a schedule, not a staircase. There is one value, '10 working days', at the end of the Diagnose bar (the System Audit). Phases already passed are solid neutral, the active phase is solid paper and planned phases are dashed outlines. Calibrate is the one red, running out through the plate edge and ending in an open paper chevron. C's sheet furniture is retired: cell walls, crosshairs, SHEET/REV cells, the mark in the title block, T+ axis captions and mono paragraphs. The plate closes on a ruled caption band, the same grammar as the nav's bottom band: one four-cell title block (FIG. 08 · Phase gantt · <phase> · Indicative) and a quiet 'Begin with the audit' door.

addressed: Kept A's clean, minimal feel: the same head, one flat plate and plenty of empty space. The climbing-blocks staircase is gone, and the chart that replaces it never steps. The four bars are separate spans with clear gaps between them, not a staircase.
C's gantt chart is the centrepiece and sits directly under the four phase columns, so the chart and the text are one design instead of two panels. Each bar lies under its own phase.
There is one obvious way in. Reading starts at '01 · Start / Diagnose' top-left and runs left to right. The animation plays in the same order: each column lights up as its bar builds underneath it.

Far less text: each phase is a name and one short line (what you get from it). The paragraphs, the labels on the bars, the spec column, the duplicate tab row, the sheet cells and the tiny mono text are all gone.
Calibrate is the section's one red: a continuous bar that runs out through the edge of the plate, because it never stops.
The timing is honest. Only Diagnose is measured (the 10-working-day System Audit), and the plate is marked 'Indicative'.
Final coherence pass: the gap between the head and the chart is now 64px, the same step every other section uses, so the page keeps one rhythm from top to bottom.
motion: entrance (kit head): the label fades in, 'We install the system.' and the light 'Then keep it sharp.' rise out of their masks (80 / 280ms), the 48×2 red rule draws, and the lede and the note fade up 12px.

the plate rises in at 380ms with all four columns waiting at 36% opacity. The ruler (the seam under the columns) plots left → right (900ms), the three bay dividers plot top → down one after another (90ms apart), and the dashed lanes fade in.
the ruler calibrates (MEASURE morph): its forty ticks arrive left → right (20ms stagger) at seeded, uneven positions, then settle onto the regular pitch (900ms --ease-inout).

orchestrated moment: the phases step every 1.2s (1.2 / 2.4 / 3.6 / 4.8s). Each time, the 2px rail slides to that column (600ms), the column lifts to full opacity, and its bar extends from its origin under it (scaleX, 800ms --ease-inout) in solid paper. The bar before it settles to the neutral 'done' tone. With Diagnose, the value at the bar's end counts 01 → 10 working days. At 04 the Calibrate bar extends in red (900ms) out through the plate edge, and its open chevron appears. The title block's state cell follows each phase. Everything has landed by about 6.0s.
ambient (the section's one loop): from about 6.0s, a 2px paper cursor runs along the red Calibrate bar, one 9.6s lap, linear, fading at both ends. It only shows while Calibrate is selected.

interaction: the four columns are real tabs (click, or ← / → keys). Selecting one jumps straight to it and stops the demo: earlier bars show as done, that bar as active (paper), and later bars as dashed 'planned' outlines. The index brightens on hover.

on the live site: plays once when the plate is 40% visible (IntersectionObserver, no pin, no scrub). It auto-steps 01 → 04 every 1.2s while in view and stops for good on the first click or key. Reduced motion renders the final markup synchronously (all bars built, Calibrate selected, red bar in place) with no timers and no cursor loop.
notes: The stage is 1129px: 128px section padding (kit .ac-sec; no ruled cut, because method follows the paper principle sheet), the kit head with an 88px statement, and a 64px gap (the page's head → figure step) to a 448px plate (a 392px field plus the ruled caption band). The markup is static and already in the final state. It is generated from one geometry: four 328px bays (dividers 328 / 656 / 984), text and bar starts at bay + 32, a tab zone of 0–168, the ruler at y 168 with ten ticks per bay at bay + 32 + 32n, bars from bay + 32 to bay + 320, and lanes at 216 + 40i. Tick jitter is seeded (mulberry32), so every render is identical. C quotas: 1 drawing, 0 leader callouts, 0 dimension lines, 0 registration marks (the figure sits in a plate), 1 title block with 4 cells, and 3 annotation words in the drawing ('10 working days'). Mono strings are '01 · Start', '02', '03', '04 · Continuous', '10 working days' and the title block, all one line and 40 characters or fewer. Red: the label squares and the 48×2 rule (family), plus the Calibrate bar as the one red moment. There is no red button; the door is a quiet underlined link to /audit. The phase lines are the outputs from Methodology.tsx, trimmed to one line each; the method itself is carried by the verbs. No mark geometry: no start square at the axis corner, no stepped or touching bars. Section numbering follows round 2: method is FIG. 08. Cross-section note: fit (the next section) carries no ruler or day count, so MEASURE is not repeated next door. The ten working days come back only as the final CTA's ten-tick ruler, and the hero's quiet note states them in words.
